short_description: CYNORA was a German deep-tech OLED emitter developer headquartered in Bruchsal near Karlsruhe. A spinoff associated with Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT), it developed thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) OLED emitter materials — notably cyBlueBooster and cyUltimateGreen — targeting more efficient blue and green OLED displays. Samsung Display acquired CYNORA's intellectual property in a transaction announced in June 2022 for a reported ~USD 300 million; the company's roughly 120 employees were terminated at the transaction.
